items.source: Look at the given environment to determine if the ManagementPortType is DISABLED, SAME or DIFFERENT.
items.translation: 查看给定的环境以确定 `ManagementPortType` 是 DISABLED、SAME 还是 DIFFERENT。

items.source: The management port and server port are different.
items.translation: 管理端口和服务器端口不同。

items.source: The management port has been disabled.
The management port is the same as the server port.
items.translation: 管理端口与服务器端口相同。

items.source: DISABLED if management.server.port is set to a negative value, SAME if management.server.port is not specified or equal to server.port and DIFFERENT otherwise.
items.translation: DISABLED 如果 management.server.port 设置为负值，SAME 如果 management.server.port 未指定或等于 server.port，以及 DIFFERENT 否则。

items.source: Returns the enum constant of this class with the specified name. The string must match exactly an identifier used to declare an enum constant in this class. (Extraneous whitespace characters are not permitted.)

items.translation: 可用于控制管理服务器启动方式的端口类型。
